evidence.reason: `record_opportunity` only inserts a new observation into a deep-copied ledger and never prunes older entries. `utilization_digest` reads only the 24-hour window (coverage.py:492-494), so retaining observations beyond that window leaves dead state and makes each tick's deep copy and digest scan grow with ledger age. Bounding retained observations to at least the digest window is a routine correctness/performance repair, not a new contract requirement.
